emergencyStopBanner.banner: {{agent}} is paused, but {{count}} run(s) are still finishing. They keep running until they finish on their own.
emergencyStopBanner.confirmDescription: The run(s) are cancelled immediately with the same code a pause-cancellation uses, so no recovery hold appears. Work resumes when the agent is resumed. This cannot be undone.

maintenanceBanner.title: Maintenance mode
maintenanceBanner.window: Maintenance for {{scope}} ({{state}}) since {{since}}: {{reason}}. New agent runs are paused; wakes are queued ({{queued}}) and will be delivered when maintenance ends.
maintenanceBanner.group: Agent maintenance ({{state}}) since {{since}}: {{reason}} — agents: {{count}}, queued wakeups: {{queued}}. New agent runs are paused; wakes are delivered when maintenance ends.

screens.placeholderBody: This screen is part of the UI 2.0 rollout plan and lands with its wave. The current data lives on the existing screen; this placeholder exists so the 2.0 frame and routing are real from day one.

connectorPanel.title: Connectors
connectorPanel.intro: Client devices that connect through the browser bridge: pairing, the domain allowlist, the signing policy and the journal of what the bridge did.

devices.title: Devices
devices.none: No devices are paired yet. Issue a pairing code and enter it in the browser extension on the client PC.

allowlist.title: Domain allowlist
allowlist.hint: One hostname per line. Only these domains (and their subdomains) may be opened by the bot; everything else is refused by the gateway and by the extension.

signing.title: Signing policy
signing.typesHint: Comma-separated action types (for example tender.submit). In per-type mode only these ask a person to confirm.
signing.off: Signing is off: every sign action is refused, whatever the mode.

journal.title: Journal
journal.empty: No journal rows match the filters.

stack.title: Stack
stack.intro: Every component the board tracks: our running version and the latest upstream release, with the update plan.
stack.empty: The stack registry has no components yet.

notes.truncated: Only the top lines are shown.

dialog.title: Schedule update for {{name}}
dialog.intro: This creates a backlog task with the plan below. Nothing is deployed here.
dialog.failed: The task could not be created: {{message}}

autonomy.title: Autonomy matrix
autonomy.intro: What each role may do on its own, what needs a human approval, and the regulations behind it. Changing a cell applies at the action point; every edit lands in the change log.
autonomy.noCompany: Select a company to edit its autonomy matrix.

matrix.title: Matrix
matrix.hint: Click a cell to cycle: allowed → approval required → forbidden. A cell without a rule uses the action's default verdict.
matrix.versionConflict: The matrix changed on the server while you edited it. Reload and apply your changes again.

regulations.title: Regulations
regulations.hint: Per-role regulations. A draft can be edited; approving freezes the text into the approved revision. Prior revisions stay retrievable.

placeholders.title: Coming with a later release
placeholders.reminders: Reminders — read-only placeholder; the reminder scheduler lands after 1.6.
placeholders.nightMode: Night mode — read-only placeholder; scheduled for a 1.6+ follow-up.
placeholders.answerChannel: Answer channel — read-only placeholder; channel routing is chosen after 1.6.

modelProviders.title: Model providers
modelProviders.intro: Provider keys for the model gateway: add a provider, rotate or remove its key, enable the models the company may use. The key is write-only — it is stored once and never shown again. Free models come first in every list; among them, free DashScope models lead (owner rule).
modelProviders.noCompany: Select a company to manage its model providers.

add.title: Add provider
add.name: Name
add.keyHint: Write-only: the key is stored in the secret store and never displayed again.

list.title: Providers
list.empty: No model providers yet. Add one to enable its models for the company.
list.modelsEmpty: No models discovered for this provider yet.
